purpose: Whole-container relatedness/exclusion groups from separately aligned DNA records, not phenotype prediction or final source admission.

container_semantics.namespace: source:<primary_id> versus reference:<source_id> remain distinct even with shared readable name.
container_semantics.record_searches: All268source DNA records and2original references searched independently; no nucleotide concatenation, sewing, trimming or contig selection.
container_semantics.aggregation: In original source-record order compute cumulative length offsets. Transform qstart/qend/sstart/send by their record offset and set qlen/slen to sum of that container record lengths. Preserve raw HSP order, alignment strings, scores, nident and gaps. Offsets exist only for numeric overlap accounting.
container_semantics.no_cross_record_hsp: Each input HSP coordinate must be within its original record before offset; no alignment can cross synthetic boundaries.
container_semantics.absent_directions: Zero only after producer streaming270query completion/self proof and byte-exact raw-to-numeric row/order verification.

grouping_interpretation: Unrounded similarity>=69.99 defines undirected edges; connected components retain every source, mutant, catalogue-extra and original-reference node as bridges. These are conservative project relatedness groups, not taxonomic assignments.
exclusion_rule: Primary excludes whole components containing either an original target reference or any direct-gp17 near-hit source seed. Report target-only exclusions and added-near-seed exclusions separately. Bas64 broad-family flag alone never seeds primary exclusion. No outcome-driven choice.

self_controls.canonical: Exact R/Python selfnident and original-span statistic both equal summed container length. Original target references require this.
self_controls.ambiguous: Exact R/Python selfcounts agreement, finite integer nident>0 and<=summed length; original-span statistic finite positive integer. Do not force100% or bound span as union coverage.
self_controls.generic_helper: Retain original helper generic comparison, including its all-base self failures; separate dataset-specific selfcheck applies this already-frozen ambiguity rule.

numeric_agreement.original_R_function: Unchanged nident_fun parsed/evaluated from pinned original source with authenticated installed R/packages. Existing genericRdriver string unchanged.
numeric_agreement.directional_nident_and_span: Exact integer equality for all68906nonself directions; absence requires validated complete input.
numeric_agreement.failure: Any unsupported adapter/R sentinel, malformed HSP, discrepancy, nonfinite value, missing pair, missing self or timeout remains unresolved HOLD. No imputation/repair or cutoff adjustment.

GPL_external_boundary.adapter: Pinned external subprocess only, no in-package import or upstream edits. External driver retains GPL notice and calls existing adapter functions.
